description: Na₂SO₃ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one S and six equivalent O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 3.09 Å. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and three longer (2.86 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.37 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.49 Å. S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and three equivalent O atoms. All S-O bond lengths are 1.55 Å. O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one S atom.
